name: SOL open-reversal ridge model
description: SOL: a ridge model (refit monthly on earlier windows) scores the open-reversal setup from the previous window's move size, its late confirmation into the boundary, Binance volume vs the same slot's 14-day median and the clock; buy the reversal side when the predicted net PnL beats 4c.
hypothesis: The surviving SOL open-reversal pockets (late-confirmed burst: sol-midrev; heavy-volume move: sol-volrev) are facets of one forced-flow overshoot, so a single fitted score concentrates the edge better than separate hard thresholds and adapts as it decays. Losers: opening takers treating the new window as a coin flip. Dev screen (research, walk-forward Apr-Aug, refit monthly): score>4c +5.2c (se 2.2, n=466, 5/5 months positive). Wrong if the engine walk-forward CI <= 0 (research fills at first-minute prints flatter engine fills: sol-overreact research +4c vs engine +0.3c in Jun-Aug), or the lockbox loses. Shares lockbox history with the sol-midrev/volrev/overreact family.
